## Tổng quan về thành phần hóa học

Loài *Cassia grandis* đã phân lập và xác định được 16 hoạt chất thuộc  về 7 nhóm gồm anthracenes, benzene and substituted derivatives, benzodioxoles, cinnamaldehydes, flavonoids, organooxygen compounds, steroids and steroid derivatives. Cấu trúc của từng nhóm trình bày chi tiết dưới đây.

<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const molecules = [
        {id: "canvas_Row0", smiles: "Cc1cc(O)c2c(c1)C(=O)c1cccc(O)c1C2=O" },
{id: "canvas_Row1", smiles: "COc1cc(O)c2c(c1)C(=O)c1cc(C)cc(O)c1C2=O" },
{id: "canvas_Row2", smiles: "CCC(CCC(C)C1CCC2C3CC=C4CC(O)CCC4(C)C3CCC12C)C(C)C" },
{id: "canvas_Row3", smiles: "O=c1c(O)c(-c2ccc(O)cc2)oc2cc(O)cc(O)c12" },
{id: "canvas_Row4", smiles: "O=C(O)c1cc(O)c2c(c1)C(=O)c1cccc(O)c1C2=O" },
{id: "canvas_Row5", smiles: "CC[C@H](CC[C@@H](C)[C@H]1CC[C@H]2[C@@H]3CC=C4CC(O)CC[C@]4(C)[C@H]3CC[C@@]21C)C(C)C" },
{id: "canvas_Row6", smiles: "O=C1c2cccc(O)c2C(=O)c2c(O)cc(CO)cc21" },
{id: "canvas_Row7", smiles: "CC[C@H](CC[C@@H](C)[C@H]1CC[C@H]2[C@@H]3CC=C4C[C@@H](O)CC[C@]4(C)[C@H]3CC[C@@]21C)C(C)C" },
{id: "canvas_Row8", smiles: "Oc1cc(O)c2c(c1)O[C@H](c1ccc(O)c(O)c1)[C@@H](O)C2" },
{id: "canvas_Row9", smiles: "O=Cc1ccc(O)cc1O" },
{id: "canvas_Row10", smiles: "COc1cc(C=O)cc(OC)c1OC" },
{id: "canvas_Row11", smiles: "COc1cc(C=CC=O)cc2c1OCO2" },
{id: "canvas_Row12", smiles: "COc1cc(OC)c(C=O)c(OC)c1" },
{id: "canvas_Row13", smiles: "COc1cc(/C=C/C=O)cc2c1OCO2" },
{id: "canvas_Row14", smiles: "C=CCc1cc(OC)c2c(c1)OCO2" },
{id: "canvas_Row15", smiles: "COc1ccc(-c2oc3cc(O)c(OC)c(O)c3c(=O)c2OC)cc1O" }
    ];
    const drawer = new SmilesDrawer.Drawer({ width: 150, height: 150 });
    molecules.forEach(mol => {
      SmilesDrawer.parse(mol.smiles, function (tree) {
        drawer.draw(tree, mol.id, "light", false);
      });
    });
  });
</script>
